text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest single-digit gains while the broader market shows negligible momentum across altcoins, suggesting a lack of conviction even as prices hold steady. Fear & Greed at extreme fear with a negative 7-day trend indicates sellers are still in control despite the price stability, reflecting deep uncertainty about near-term direction. At 56.6% dominance and $53B daily volume, capital appears to be rotating defensively toward Bitcoin rather than flowing into risk assets.
